{
  "source_id": "BOOK-013",
  "title": "CIDOB political biography",
  "url": "https://www.cidob.org/lider-politico/andres-manuel-lopez-obrador",

  "document_type": "biography",
  "source_role": "independent_reference",
  "target_year": 2022,
  "ruler": "Andrés Manuel López Obrador",
  "country": "Mexico",
  "chapter": "5B",
  "scope_note": "Extract covers life through end of 2018; only a small portion bears directly on 2022 conditions. Most 5B-relevant material is programmatic 2018–2024 framing, not measured 2022 outcomes.",
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-001",
      "type": "observed_fact",
      "claim": "Edit/update note states version published 29/11/2018; AMLO term 1 Dec 2018 – 1 Oct 2024; successor Claudia Sheinbaum (MORENA/Sigamos Haciendo Historia), elected 2/6/2024.",
      "locator": "Block 1, update note"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-002",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "Declared first Mexican president 'nítidamente de izquierda'; took office 1 Dec 2018 with absolute coalition majority in both chambers; began with renunciation of 'atributos dispendiosos'.",
      "locator": "Block 6"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-003",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "2018 program (Juntos Haremos Historia) centered on 'austeridad republicana' (redirect current spending to investment, no tax hikes); addressing poverty; gradual military withdrawal from internal security with 3-year 'pacification' goal; raising domestic gasoline supply; energy and food self-sufficiency with guaranteed prices for smallholders; 'erradication' of political corruption 'dando ejemplo'; defending migrants.",
      "locator": "Block 5"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-004",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "2018–2024 platform described as 'socialdemocracia pragmática' accepting free-market orthodoxy, macroeconomic stability, fiscal discipline, peso float — alongside rejection of 'tendencias privatizadoras' and 'extranjerización' of strategic sectors; priority to 'producción nacional'.",
      "locator": "Block 6"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-005",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "AMLO signaled 'hacer justicia sin venganza' and stated 'no voy a meter a Peña Nieto en la cárcel'.",
      "locator": "Block 6"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-006",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "Pre-inauguration initiatives: 'Constitución Moral' guiding 'Cuarta Transformación' (4T), Consulta Nacional Ciudadana on priority programs, and Plan Nacional de Paz y Seguridad establishing Guardia Nacional and offering 'amnistía condicionada' for narcos; team also studying decriminalization of soft drugs.",
      "locator": "Block 6"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-007",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "AMLO viewed USMCA as 'beneficioso'; in October 2018 proposed visas de trabajo for Central American migrants; on 26/11/2018, after a repelled border assault, Trump threatened to close the border 'permanentemente'.",
      "locator": "Block 7"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-008",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "2000–2005 DF government pursued obras públicas and the Pensión Universal Alimenticia para Adultos Mayores; resisted implementing Seguro Popular on the grounds that DF residents already had free municipal coverage.",
      "locator": "Block 21"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-009",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "PAN accused AMLO of 'derrochar' the DF budget with populist spending; DF debt did grow, but 'a ritmo sensiblemente menor que bajo anteriores gobiernos' (assertion, no source).",
      "locator": "Block 21"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-010",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "2006 platform: end 'privilegios' and corruption 'de arriba para abajo', cut president's salary in half, investigate FOBAPROA via a Comisión de la Verdad; estimated 100,000 million pesos first-year savings from austerity.",
      "locator": "Blocks 30–31"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-011",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "2006 stance: no privatization of Pemex; right to a 'justo y digno' salary without specifying amount; adding a development cooperation chapter to TLCAN; migration addressed 'sin muros ni militarización'.",
      "locator": "Block 31"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-012",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "2006 FOBAPROA described as 'fraude más grande de la historia después de La Conquista' and openly unconstitutional (in AMLO book 'Fobaproa, expediente abierto: reseña y archivo').",
      "locator": "Block 17"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-013",
      "type": "interpretation",
      "claim": "The author frames AMLO's 2018 victory as the debut of a new opposition party (MORENA) after decades of PRI–PAN duopoly, with a 'socialdemocracia pragmática' platform.",
      "locator": "Blocks 2, 6"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-014",
      "type": "interpretation",
      "claim": "Two Camps of authoring evaluative framing: AMLO as 'voluntarioso y esforzado' purveyor of social causes, austere, transparent, participative (Block 19); vs. 'extremista', 'populista', 'mesías tropical' (Krauze) for adversaries (Blocks 20–21, 29).",
      "locator": "Blocks 19–21, 29"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-015",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "His 'mañaneras' (early-AM press conferences) 'marcaron la agenda política del país'.",
      "locator": "Block 20"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-016",
      "type": "unresolved_allegation",
      "claim": "Videoescándalo 2004: Bejarano, Ponce, Ímaz filmed with Carlos Ahumada Kurtz; AMLO characterized scandal as 'conspiración' (alleging Salinas, Fernández de Cevallos, Fox, U.S. Treasury/DEA complicity); author notes it was 'objetivamente' hard to imagine AMLO unaware of Bejarano's dealings but AMLO was not personally implicated.",
      "locator": "Blocks 22–23"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-017",
      "type": "observed_fact",
      "claim": "2004 desafuero: 7 April 2005, Chamber voted 360–127–2 (PAN, PRI in favor; PRD, PT, Convergencia against; PVEM split) to lift immunity; 4 May 2005 new PGR Cabeza de Vaca withdrew charges; 27 April Fox accepted resignation of procurador Macedo de la Concha.",
      "locator": "Blocks 25–27"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-018",
      "type": "observed_fact",
      "claim": "2006 election official result: Calderón 35.89% vs AMLO 35.31% (margin 0.58% / 243,934 votes); TEPJF 5 Sept 2006 validated elections; recount annulled 237,000 votes, margin narrowed to 0.56%.",
      "locator": "Blocks 33, 35"
    },
    {
      "id": "AMLO-2022-5B-019",
      "type": "author_assertion",
      "claim": "AMLO self-proclaimed 'presidente legítimo' on 16 Nov 2006; organized parallel 'gobierno alterno' / Convención Nacional Democrática, refusing to recognize Calderón.",
      "locator": "Blocks 36–37"
    }
  ],
  "limitations": [
    "Extract is the 2018 publication; not updated for 2022 economic outcomes, debt levels, inflation, or program execution.",
    "No quantitative 5B indicators (GDP growth, poverty rate, inflation, debt/GDP, FDI, audit findings) appear in this text.",
    "Most 5B-relevant passages are pre-inauguration plans or 2018–2024 programmatic intent; implementation evidence is absent.",
    "2018 'Plan Nacional de Paz y Seguridad' and 'amnistía condicionada' referenced only at announcement level in extracted units.",
    "Treats 5B-relevant priors (DF term 2000–2005, 2006/2012 platforms) as context; no 2018–2022 execution data.",
    "American Folk trend of biographical prose: blends author interpretation, popular reputation, and second-hand synthesis; 'difícil imaginar que no estuviera al corriente' is interpretive, not evidentiary."
  ],
  "contrary_or_unresolved_material": [
    "Opposition characterization of AMLO as 'extremista', 'populista', 'mesías tropical' (Krauze) vs. biography's own sympathetic framing (Blocks 19–21, 29).",
    "PAN/PRI claim of DF budget 'derroche' vs. author's caveat that debt grew but slower than under prior administrations (Block 21).",
    "AMLO's conspiracy theory on the videoescándalo (alleging Salinas, Fox, U.S. agencies) presented but not corroborated with evidence (Block 23).",
    "AMLO's 2006–2018 fraud claims were rejected by IFE, TEPJF, EU, OAS, UN missions; author reports these conclusions but includes AMLO's continued rejection (Blocks 33–36)."
  ],

    "5B.5 anti-corruption (5B.5) — needs post-2018 audit/SFP data and prosecutions of ex-presidents beyond AMLO's 'no venganza' statement; not in extract.",
    "5B.9 crisis response — 2022 inflation, post-pandemic recovery, peso performance, USMCA implementation are not discussed in this 2018 snapshot.",
    "5B.8 distributional effects — needs post-2018 data on pensions, Becas Benito Juárez, Jóvenes Construyendo el Futuro coverage and targeting; not in extract.",
    "5B.2 economic cabinet — only a passing reference to Sheinbaum as ex-jefa de Gobierno del DF (Block 1); no 2018 cabinet roster visible in these units."
  ],
  "bias_controls": [
    "Do not equate the 2018 'first left president' framing with verifiable 2022 outcomes.",
    "Treat maquiavélico block (Block 21) PAN accusations and AMLO counterclaims symmetrically.",
    "Phrases like 'moralmente imposible', 'espurio', 'pelele', 'mesías tropical' are partisan rhetoric — not evidence.",
    "English-style vs. Spanish-style sources: PAN EU/OAS/UN endorsements are described as endorsements of electoral cleanliness, not validation of AMLO's economic program."
  ],
  "continuation": null
}
